title.en: Gimai ga Seijo dakara to Konyakuhaki Saremashita ga, Watashi wa Yousei no Itoshigo desu
Kawaii Gimai ga Konyakuhaki Saretarashii no de, Ima kara "Orei" ni Mairimasu
Kizoku kara Shomin ni Natta no de, Kon'yaku wo Kaishou Saremashita!
Kinou made Namae mo Yonde Kurenakatta Koushaku-sama ga, Kyuu ni Dekiai shitekuru no desu ga?
Eiyuu-sama, Wakeari Osanazuma wa Ikaga desu ka?
Usotsuki Heika ga Watashi ni Shuuchaku Suru Riyuu

title.ja-ro: Kanpeki Sugite Kawaigeganai to Kon'yaku Hakisareta Seijo wa Ringoku ni Urareru

title.en: Kon'yaku Haki o Neratte Kioku Soushitsu no Furi o Shitara, Sokkenai Taido datta Kon'yakusha ga "Kioku o Ushinau Mae no Kimi wa, Ore ni Betabore datta" to Iu, Tondemonai Uso o Tsuki Hajimeta
Betabore no Kon'yakusha ga Akuyaku Reijou ni Sare Sou na no de.
Mujikaku Seijo wa Kyou mo Muishiki ni Chikara wo Tarenagasu
Suterare Hanayome no Saikon - Koori no Henkyou Haku wa Saiai o Chikau
Kakure Saijo wa Zenzen Megenai: Gibo to Gimai ni Ie o Oidasareta no de Kon'yaku Haki shite Moraou to Omottara, Shinshi Datta Kon'yakusha ga Hageshiku Dekiai shite kuru you ni narimashita!?
Reiketsu Ryuuou Heika no "Unmei no Tsugai" rashii Desu ga, Koukyuu ni Hikikomorou to Omoimasu
Konyaku Haki no Akui wa Shoukan Kara Okaeshi Shimasu
Iekara Nigedashitai Watashi ga, Ukkari Akogare no Daimahoutsukai-sama wo Katteshimattara
